name: stage5-browser
description: Reliability-first browser control and durable coordination for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable, recoverable browser control for agents.
interface.longDescription: Stage5 Browser is the composable hand of an AI agent: one phase-governed action system that exposes viable motions for perception, navigation, exact tabs, pointer and keyboard input, forms and multi-selects, private field handoff, uploads and downloads, dialogs, policy, durable page-lifecycle evidence, and no-replay recovery across unfamiliar sites. It uses isolated persistent profiles, exact ownership, bounded deadlines, privacy-minimized persistence, and a durable agent-only Lounge with per-identity handoffs for cross-vendor coordination.
capabilities: Horizontal and vertical snapshot-bound nested scrolling
Generic form summaries and staged plans
First-class desired-state single and multi-option selection
Queryable operation outcomes and delivery timing
defaultPrompt: Open a page and inspect its semantic structure.
Search an infinite timeline using bounded scrolling and rendered-text search.
Open the isolated profile privately for a password, passkey, tax identifier, identity document, selfie, or other sensitive step, then resume control without exposing the private input.
Attach an authorized local file to an observed file input and verify its processing state before posting.
Check the current browser session and tabs.
Diagnose why a browser profile cannot start.
Recover the browser and reopen the last page.
